info.description: A piano/keyboard diagram, addressed by pitch class rather than fretboard position. mode=theory stores musical parameters and computes marks at render; mode=explicit stores hand-placed marks. Split from lesson.diagram (which is fretboard-only, guitar/bass) because MiniKeyboard's marks are pitch-class-addressed, a different shape than MiniNeck's position-addressed dots — stringSet/inversion/fromFret/toFret would be meaningless-but-structurally-valid here.
